author: CreeperReaperX
body: The new teams are always put at the last of the list. I know this because I recently made the Creeper Crushers. Now I'm not trying to just advertise my team, but go to the end of the list or near the end so that the new starting out teams can have a shot at winning something. Just a thought.

replies.author: kycrafft
replies.body: It makes sense for the larger teams to be on the front page because they hold the influence and majority of the players that will be participating in the team events. The teams with lower player counts won't be able to play, giving them a lower status on the team pages. If you want to give your new team a shot at winning, there is always the Looking For Members subforum.

replies.author: CreeperReaperX
replies.body: Really, I just want the best for every team. I know I can't make that happen, but I can try my best. Some people want a team, and only have themselves on it. It's been like that for 4 months, according to the forum. Some teams prosper, others don't so much. I just want to give them a chance to feel good.
